summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting  **What I did to prepare this plan:** read the client (`WatchlistPage.tsx`, `api.ts`, `useAuth.tsx`), the server (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`, `schema.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `db/auth.ts`, `server.ts`, `db/index.ts`), and the dev proxy config — no edits made.  **What I found (important — corrects an initial wrong lead):** A first-pass subagent scan claimed the bug was that `watchlistRouter`'s own auth middleware injects `X-User-Id` via `c.req.raw.headers.set()` and that Hono doesn't propagate it to downstream handlers. I check
